title: DOH LIFTS SMOKE ADVISORY RELATED TO FIRE AT ABC TOWING & PARTS IN PEARL CITY
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) has lifted the smoke advisory issued in response to the fire at ABC Towing & Parts in Pearl City.
